title: Retrieve the Admin Password From Handover Documentation (Admin Password Reference)
summary: Use the handover documentation as the source of truth for the OptiSweep admin password. If the password is not present, coordinate with Michael Thomas and follow the referenced handover forms/links and handover checklist timing (checklist completed in January of last year).
when_to_use: When you need the documented OptiSweep admin password for accessing/administering the system and the source indicates it should be contained in the handover documentation.
not_for: Do not guess or attempt alternative passwords if the admin password is not found in the handover documentation.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Locate the handover documentation and search for the admin password entry; if missing, coordinate with Michael Thomas per the referenced guidance.
access_or_tools_needed: Contact path to Michael Thomas (as referenced by the source)

external_references: Handover documentation and handover checklist/forms/links referenced by the source

visual_references.description: Video frame containing the spoken instruction that the admin password should be in the handover documentation and to get with Michael Thomas if needed (includes mention of forms/links and January handover checklist timing).

success_criteria: Admin password is obtained from the handover documentation, OR the named contact (Michael Thomas) is identified/engaged to retrieve it when missing.
healthy_conditions: The handover documentation contains an “admin password” entry that can be recorded.
If missing, Michael Thomas is contacted and the referenced forms/links process is followed.
failure_conditions: Admin password is not found in the handover documentation and passwords are guessed.
No escalation/coordination occurs when the password is missing.
escalation_guidance: If the admin password cannot be found in the handover documentation, coordinate with Michael Thomas as referenced (including filling out forms and providing links).
